purpose: Exact raw-Android GNSS/PDC contract comparison against the pinned taroz MATLAB specification. This record does not claim full upstream equivalence.

inference_inputs: raw device_imu.csv only for a future IMU lane
policy.ground_truth: ground_truth.csv may be opened only after a frozen native output is sealed for a declared development score.

raw_loader.contract: Android TimeNanos/FullBiasNanos/ReceivedSvTimeNanos are required; any .mat path is rejected before open; raw rows only.
mapping: raw receiver clock to GPST using integer nanosecond arithmetic
GLONASS transmit time converted to GPST
BeiDou transmit time shifted by 14 seconds
carrier ADR metres divided by observed wavelength
five-device ADR sign policy copied from gnsslog2obs.m

dedicated_solver.input_boundary: raw loader is called directly; optional WlsPosition* columns are ignored; native SPP supplies a truth-free seed
dedicated_solver.state: per-epoch ECEF position delta, five clock groups, ECEF velocity, clock drift

matrix.upstream_contract: gnsslog2obs.m builds raw P/L/D and status matrices; exobs.m applies signal status, SNR, multipath, range and TDCP-jump masks; exobs_residuals.m applies elevation, residual, P-D and L-D masks; correct_pseudorange.m subtracts smoothed base residuals and antenna offset; obserrmodel.m derives SNR/elevation dependent sigmas.
implemented: raw timing and status validity gates
exobs code-lock/TOW/TOD status masks when State is present
exobs SNR>=20 and smartphone MultipathIndicator masks
exobs pseudorange physical range mask 1e7..4e7 m
exobs ADR valid/slip masks and published GLONASS carrier exclusions
missing_or_mismatched: residual-stage P-D and L-D prefilters remain outside the compact Observation API
P-D and L-D residual prefilters are not ported
SNR percentile and signal-specific published obserrmodel are not used
base compensation is unavailable under raw/nav-only contract because correct_pseudorange.m requires base_position.csv/base_offset.csv; no substitute is inferred
matrix.impact: high; this is the earliest substantive accuracy gap after raw decoding

matrix.upstream_contract: gnsslog2obs.m estimates nearest supported frequencies and sysfreq2sigtype.m maps L1/L5 signal types; GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou mappings are selected by constellation/frequency.
missing_or_mismatched: full upstream frequency matrix beyond the raw Android signals above
upstream per-signal sigtype factors are not yet wired into solver weights
matrix.impact: medium; raw route diagnostics prove nonzero L1/L5/Galileo/GLONASS coverage

matrix.upstream_contract: fgo_gnss.m:89-121 initializes ENU position/velocity, a seven-element clock vector and clock drift; lines 123-152 add PseudorangeFactor_XC and DopplerFactor_VD; lines 154-201 add motion, clock and ordinary TDCP factors.
implemented: satellite velocity and Sagnac rate terms in Doppler
missing_or_mismatched: native solver uses ECEF deltas rather than upstream ENU local states
native clock model has five groups rather than upstream seven-element vector
native float carrier residuals are retained for diagnostics but do not reproduce upstream gtsam_gnss ambiguity-state contracts
native graph is Eigen IRLS, not gtsam_gnss factor implementations
matrix.impact: high; state/factor contract mismatch limits direct score equivalence

matrix.upstream_contract: gnsslog2obs.m tracks hardware clock discontinuities and carrier LLI/state; exobs_residuals.m resets/rejects carrier and TDCP inconsistencies; fgo_gnss.m suppresses TDCP at clock jumps and selects phone-specific TDCP factor clock states.
missing_or_mismatched: no explicit upstream per-arc ambiguity state in the state vector
no full P-D/L-D residual arc mask
phone-specific GLONASS carrier exclusions are not all represented
matrix.impact: high for carrier accuracy; no integer fixing is attempted

matrix.upstream_contract: parameters.m:62-128 fixes masks, signal factors, Huber kernels, residual limits, and Loffset; fgo_gnss.m:123-152 wraps P/D factors with those robust kernels.
missing_or_mismatched: published SNR-percentile sigma model
upstream signal factors and P/D/L residual thresholds
phone/setting-dependent kernel parameters
matrix.impact: medium/high; do not tune thresholds from truth until exact mapping is ported

matrix.upstream_contract: fgo_gnss.m optimizes the declared [IdxStart,IdxEnd] range as one graph and run_fgo.m controls route settings; no native equivalent of the MATLAB setting-table orchestration is currently exposed.
missing_or_mismatched: setting-table route schedule
upstream start/end and carry-over semantics
published window/postprocessing orchestration
matrix.impact: medium; structural portability gap rather than a raw parser bug

matrix.upstream_contract: fgo_gnss.m:34-48 initializes from posbl/gradient/clock state when initflag is true, otherwise loads the prior GNSS solution; fgo_gnss.m:63-70 computes ENU LOS around the initial origin.
implemented: explicit rejection of --seed-pos in raw mode
missing_or_mismatched: no upstream posbl/gradient setting-table path
no ENU-origin state initialization
native SPP fallback is intentionally not a claim of upstream equivalence
matrix.impact: high for convergence/linearization; current route structural run is finite and convergent

matrix.upstream_contract: parameters.m:176-203 declares IMU noise, offsets, mounting, stop and height parameters; fgo_gnss_imu.m adds IMU/preintegration factors.
missing_or_mismatched: raw-only GNSS PDC app intentionally does not consume device_imu.csv
no attitude, preintegration, bias or mounting transform in this lane
must be a separate opt-in phase after GNSS contract is exact
matrix.impact: high potential upside but out of scope for this GNSS-only bridge

matrix.upstream_contract: fgo_gnss.m:203-218 uses GTSAM Levenberg-Marquardt with maxIterations=1000 and returns optimizer error/iterations.
missing_or_mismatched: GTSAM LM damping/linearization/stopping parity
upstream factor noise models and robust m-estimator semantics
matrix.impact: high; backend parity is required before claiming a native score near the imported external baseline

matrix.upstream_contract: fgo_gnss.m:220-253 converts ENU output, applies add_position_offset.m, writes result; submission.m defines official key projection/order.
missing_or_mismatched: upstream antenna position offset/attitude postprocessing
official sample-key reordering is deliberately outside the raw solver
no external submission is performed
matrix.impact: medium; output contract is sufficient for declared train raw evaluation

conclusion.next_exact_component: port the raw-status/mask and raw/nav-derived observation error contracts without base compensation; keep base correction explicitly unavailable under the no-MAT/raw-only contract
conclusion.structural_route_evidence: A raw-only Release run on 2023-05-24-20-26-us-ca-sjc-ge2/pixel7pro completed 1,384 finite epochs with nonzero P/D/ordinary-TDCP factors and no native SPP failures; this is a plumbing result, not an accuracy claim.
